text:
Irhythm Technologies Inc (NASDAQ:IRTC) Has Decline in Shorts Posted by Ellis Scott 04 pm
The stock of Irhythm Technologies Inc (NASDAQ:IRTC) registered a decrease of 6.05% in short interest. IRTC’s total short interest was 1.96 million shares in December as published by FINRA. Its down 6.05% from 2.08M shares, reported previously. With 386,400 shares average volume, it will take short sellers 5 days to cover their IRTC’s short positions. The short interest to Irhythm Technologies Inc’s float is 9.03%.
The stock increased 0.90% or $0.62 during the last trading session, reaching $69.48. About 164,909 shares traded. iRhythm Technologies, Inc. (NASDAQ:IRTC) has risen 37.91% since December 31, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 37.91% the S&P500.
iRhythm Technologies, Inc., a digital healthcare company, focuses on the provision of ambulatory electrocardiogram, or ECG, monitoring for patients at risk for arrhythmias in the United States. The company has market cap of $1.68 billion. It offers ZIO Service, a platform that provides wearable biosensor with cloud data analytics that distill data from heartbeats into clinically actionable information. It currently has negative earnings.
